description: This file is a source code file in C related to Wi-Fi event handling and interface management within a wireless driver or component. It contains implementations for handling WPA control events, interface creation/deletion, scan results, DFS radar events, management frames, and associated callback functions for Wi-Fi access points and endpoints.
